_comment: Class schedule. Codes are the readable call-number parts: ROOM.SHELF/author/CHAPTER/date. Add a shelf = add an entry under shelves; chapter regexes are matched in order, first hit wins.
_github_repo: owner/name of the GitHub repo that #N issue and PR numbers in facts refer to; dates.py reads their creation dates with `gh api`. Omit it and that date source is skipped.
